title: Figure 8: fusion ignition energies (cross-section) for D-T, D-D and D-He3
description: Log-scale graph of cross section (barns) versus deuteron energy (keV, 0–100), with three curves: D-T (blue dashed, highest), D-D (red solid) and D-He3 (green dash-dot, rising from about 30 keV). Above it, Figure 7 lists "Low Temperature Fusion Reactions" as equations with energy yields. Captioned "Figure 8. Fusion Ignition Energies for D-T, D-D, and D-He3," with text explaining reaction probabilities and temperatures.
